translations.idiomatic: As the army approached Wukou, Rongxian rode ahead with a few men to scout and met several dozen enemy horsemen. When his companions started to fall back he said, "They outnumber us; if we show fear they will overrun us."

sentences.zh: 援弓策馬，射殺兩人，乃還。

translations.literal: He drew his bow, spurred his horse, shot and killed two men, and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: He strung his bow, charged, killed two men, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 進拔五河口，陞權行軍萬戶，守宿州。

translations.literal: Advancing he took Wuhekou, was promoted to acting campaign ten-thousand-household, and garrisoned Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then captured Wukou, was promoted to acting campaign ten-thousand-household, and garrisoned Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 墮馬傷股，不能復從軍，改提領本路課稅，又改本路諸軍鎮撫，兼提控經歷司。

translations.literal: Falling from a horse he injured his thigh and could not again follow the army; he was changed to oversee this circuit's tax levies, again changed to this circuit's overall pacification of all troops, concurrently controlling the experience office.
translations.idiomatic: A fall from his horse injured his thigh and ended his field service. He was put in charge of the circuit's taxes, then made overall pacifier of the circuit's forces with concurrent control of the experience office.

sentences.zh: 值斷事官鉤校諸路積逋，官吏往往遭詬辱，榮顯從容辦理，悉為蠲貸。

translations.literal: It happened that the judicial officer audited accumulated arrears in the various circuits; officials and clerks often suffered abuse and insult; Rongxian handled matters calmly and all were remitted and lent.
translations.idiomatic: When a judicial officer audited tax arrears across the circuits, officials were often humiliated. Rongxian handled the accounts calmly and secured remissions for all.

sentences.zh: 從實入朝，授東平路緫管府參議，兼領博州防禦使。

translations.literal: Following Shi to court he was appointed counselor of the Dongping Circuit Directorate and concurrently defender of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: When he followed Shi to court he was made counselor of the Dongping circuit directorate and concurrent defender of Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 時十投下議各分所屬，不隸東平，榮顯力辯於朝，遂止。

translations.literal: At that time the ten touxia discussed each dividing their subordinates and not belonging to Dongping; Rongxian forcefully argued at court and it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the ten touxia sought to divide their subjects away from Dongping's jurisdiction, Rongxian argued forcefully at court and stopped the plan.

sentences.zh: 及攻淮南，道出東平，民間供給，費銀二萬錠，榮顯詣斷事官愬之，得折充賦稅，民賴以不困。

translations.literal: When attacking Huainan the route passed through Dongping; civilian supply cost twenty thousand ingots of silver; Rongxian went to the judicial officer to plead; it was allowed to be offset against tax levies and the people relied on this not to be distressed.
translations.idiomatic: The Huainan campaign passed through Dongping, costing the people twenty thousand ingots in supplies. Rongxian appealed to the judicial officer and won an offset against taxes, sparing the populace.

sentences.zh: 中統元年，謁告侍親，閑居十年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong he requested leave to attend his parents, lived in retirement ten years, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1260 he took leave to care for his parents, lived in retirement for ten years, and died.

sentences.zh: 石天祿

translations.literal: Shi Tianlu.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Tianlu

sentences.zh: 石天祿，父珪，山東諸路都元帥，陷金，死節，見忠義傳。

translations.literal: Shi Tianlu—his father Gui was overall marshal of the Shandong circuits; trapped by Jin he died maintaining integrity, recorded in the Loyalty and Righteousness biography.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Tianlu's father Gui was overall marshal of the Shandong circuits; trapped by the Jin he died defending his post, as told in the biography of the loyal and righteous.

sentences.zh: 天祿襲爵，孛魯承制授龍虎衛上將軍、東平路元帥，佩金虎符。

translations.literal: Tianlu inherited the title; the Prince of Lu acting by order appointed him Grand General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard and marshal of the Dongping Circuit, wearing a gold tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Tianlu inherited the rank. The Prince of Lu, acting by order, made him Grand General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard and marshal of Dongping, with a gold tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 時宋將彭義斌取大名及中山，天祿與孛里海率兵敗之，獲義斌。

translations.literal: At that time the Song general Peng Yibin took Daming and Zhongshan; Tianlu with Bolihai led troops and defeated him, capturing Yibin.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song general Peng Yibin seized Daming and Zhongshan, Tianlu and Bolihai defeated him and captured Yibin.

sentences.zh: 又敗金將武仙，屢立戰功。

translations.literal: Again he defeated the Jin general Wu Xian and repeatedly established battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: He also defeated the Jin commander Wu Xian and won distinction again and again.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，孛魯以功奏，遷金紫光祿大夫、都元帥，鎮戍邊隅，數與金人戰，未嘗敗北。

translations.literal: In bingxu Bolu reported his merit; he was transferred to Gold-Purple Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and overall marshal, garrisoning the border regions; several times he fought Jin men and never suffered defeat in the north.
translations.idiomatic: In 1226 Bolu reported his merits and he was made Gold-Purple Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and overall marshal on the frontier, fighting the Jin repeatedly without a northern defeat.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，皇太弟拖雷南渡河，天祿為前鋒，戰退金兵，奪戰船數艘。

translations.literal: In renchen the Imperial Younger Brother Tolui crossed the Yellow River south; Tianlu was vanguard, fought and repelled Jin troops, and seized several war boats.
translations.idiomatic: In 1232 Prince Tolui crossed the Yellow River south. Tianlu led the vanguard, drove back Jin forces, and seized several warships.

sentences.zh: 夜至歸德城下，襲其營，殺三百餘人。

translations.literal: At night he reached below Guide city, raided their camp, and killed more than three hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: That night he reached Guide, raided the camp, and killed more than three hundred men.

sentences.zh: 金將陳防禦出兵追圍天祿，天祿潰圍復戰，金兵退走。

translations.literal: The Jin general Chen the Defender led troops out in pursuit and surrounded Tianlu; Tianlu broke the encirclement and fought again; Jin troops retreated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin defender Chen pursued and surrounded him. Tianlu broke out, fought again, and forced the Jin troops to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 提兵掠亳及徐，所過望風附降。

translations.literal: Leading troops he raided Bo and Xu; wherever he passed they submitted at the wind's report.
translations.idiomatic: He raided through Bo and Xu, and every place he passed submitted at once.

sentences.zh: 癸巳秋九月，破考城，復圍歸德。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn in guisi he broke Kaocheng and again besieged Guide.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of 1233 he took Kaocheng and again besieged Guide.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，歸德降。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter Guide surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Guide surrendered that winter.

sentences.zh: 甲午，入覲，改授征行千戶，濟、兗、單三州管民緫管。

translations.literal: In jiawu he had audience and was changed to campaign thousand-household and overall civilian commander of Ji, Yan, and Shan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In 1234 he attended court and was reassigned as campaign thousand-household and overall civilian commander of Ji, Yan, and Shan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，從扎剌溫火兒赤渡淮，攻隨州，至襄陽夾河寨，戰退宋兵，扎剌溫火兒赤賞以戰馬。

translations.literal: In yiwei he followed Zhalawen Huo'erchi in crossing the Huai, attacked Suizhou, reached the Jiahe stockade at Xiangyang, fought and repelled Song troops; Zhalawen Huo'erchi rewarded him with a war horse.
translations.idiomatic: In 1235 he followed Zhalawen Huo'erchi across the Huai, attacked Suizhou, fought Song forces at the Jiahe stockade near Xiangyang, and received a war horse as reward.

sentences.zh: 又從攻蘄、黃，功居其首。

translations.literal: Again he followed in attacking Qi and Huang; his merit ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: He also joined attacks on Qi and Huang, ranking first in merit.

sentences.zh: 時詔天祿括戶東平，軍民賦稅並依天祿已括籍冊，嚴實不得科收。

translations.literal: At that time an edict ordered Tianlu to register households in Dongping; military and civilian taxes all followed Tianlu's already registered books; Yan Shi could not levy and collect.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then had Tianlu register households in Dongping; military and civilian taxes followed only his registers, and Yan Shi could no longer collect separately.

sentences.zh: 天祿以病不任職，以子興祖襲。

translations.literal: Tianlu because of illness could not hold office; his son Xingzu inherited.
translations.idiomatic: When illness left Tianlu unable to serve, his son Xingzu inherited.

sentences.zh: 明年，天祿卒，年五十四。

translations.literal: The next year Tianlu died, age fifty-four.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Tianlu died at fifty-four.

sentences.zh: 子十人，興祖襲千戶，官武略將軍。

translations.literal: He had ten sons; Xingzu inherited the thousand-household post and was appointed General of Martial Strategy.
translations.idiomatic: He had ten sons. Xingzu inherited the thousand-household rank and was made General of Martial Strategy.

sentences.zh: 己未，從伐宋，攻鄂州。

translations.literal: In jiwei he followed in campaigning against Song and attacked Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1259 he joined the campaign against the Song and attacked Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 至元四年，繇宿州率兵抄沿淮諸郡，獲宋覘伺者十餘輩，統軍司賞馬二十匹、銀五百兩、錦二十端。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiyuan he led troops from Suzhou to raid the prefectures along the Huai, captured more than ten Song scouts, and the overall command rewarded twenty horses, five hundred taels of silver, and twenty bolts of brocade.
translations.idiomatic: In 1267 he led troops from Suzhou in raids along the Huai, captured more than ten Song scouts, and received twenty horses, five hundred taels of silver, and twenty bolts of brocade.

sentences.zh: 十二年，攻常州，為先鋒，功在諸將上。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he attacked Changzhou as vanguard; his merit was above the generals.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 he attacked Changzhou as vanguard, outshining the other commanders.

sentences.zh: 宋亡，第功，陞宣武將軍、管軍緫管，戍溫州。

translations.literal: When Song perished merit was ranked; he was advanced to General of Manifest Martiality and overall troop commander, garrisoning Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After the Song fell his merit was ranked highest. He was made General of Manifest Martiality and overall commander, garrisoning Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 土賊林大年等搆亂，出兵圍之，斬首千餘級，招輯南溪山寨歸農者三萬餘戶。

translations.literal: Local bandits Lin Danian and others stirred disorder; he led troops to surround them, beheaded heads in excess of a thousand, and summoned and gathered more than thirty thousand households of the Nanxi mountain stockades back to farming.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits such as Lin Danian rose, he surrounded them, took more than a thousand heads, and brought more than thirty thousand households of the Nanxi mountain stockades back to farming.

sentences.zh: 十六年，陞顯武將軍，佩金虎符。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was advanced to General of Manifest Martiality and wore a gold tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In 1279 he was promoted to Manifest Martial General and given a gold tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 十九年七月，卒于軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the nineteenth year he died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He died in camp in the seventh month of 1282.

sentences.zh: 子璡嗣。

translations.literal: His son Jin inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jin inherited.

sentences.zh: 石抹阿辛

translations.literal: Shimo Axin.
translations.idiomatic: Shimo Axin

sentences.zh: 石抹阿辛，迪列糾氏。

translations.literal: Shimo Axin was of the Diliejiu clan.
translations.idiomatic: Shimo Axin belonged to the Diliejiu clan.

sentences.zh: 歲乙亥，率北京等路民一萬二千餘戶來歸，太師、國王木華黎奏授鎮國上將軍、御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the year yihai he led more than twelve thousand households of the people of the Northern Capital and other circuits to submit; Grand Preceptor and Prince Muqali memorialized and appointed him Grand General Who Stabilizes the State and Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1215 he led more than twelve thousand households from the northern capital region to submit. Grand Preceptor and Prince Muqali appointed him Grand General Who Stabilizes the State and censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 從擊蠡州，死焉。

translations.literal: Following in attacking Lizhou he died there.
translations.idiomatic: He died fighting at Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 子查剌，仍以御史大夫領黑軍。

translations.literal: His son Zhala still held the post of Censor-in-Chief and led the Black Army.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhala succeeded as censor-in-chief and commanded the Black Army.

sentences.zh: 初，其父阿辛所將軍，皆猛士，衣黑為號，故曰黑軍。

translations.literal: At first the army his father Axin commanded were all fierce warriors who wore black as their mark, and therefore were called the Black Army.
translations.idiomatic: The troops his father had commanded were fierce warriors who dressed in black, hence the name Black Army.

sentences.zh: 歲己卯，詔黑軍分屯真定、固安、太原、平陽、隰、吉、岢嵐間。

translations.literal: In the year jimao an edict ordered the Black Army garrisoned separately at Zhending, Gu'an, Taiyuan, Pingyang, Xi, Ji, and Kelan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1219 an edict posted the Black Army at Zhending, Gu'an, Taiyuan, Pingyang, Xi, Ji, Kelan, and other points.

sentences.zh: 頃之南征，以黑軍為前列。

translations.literal: Before long on the southern campaign the Black Army was made the front column.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, on the southern campaign, they formed the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 與南兵遇于河，查剌大呼馳之，陷其陣，渡河再戰，盡殪之，所遇城邑爭先款附，長驅擣汴州，入自仁和門，收圖籍，振旅而還。

translations.literal: Meeting southern troops at the river, Zhala shouted loudly and charged, broke their formation, crossed the river and fought again, slaughtered them all; wherever city and district were encountered they competed to submit first; long-driving they struck Bianzhou, entered by the Renhe Gate, collected maps and registers, and with disciplined troops returned.
translations.idiomatic: At the river Zhala charged the southern line, broke it, crossed and fought again, and annihilated the enemy. City after city submitted. He drove to Bianzhou, entered by the Renhe Gate, gathered maps and registers, and withdrew in good order.

sentences.zh: 論功，黑軍為最。

translations.literal: Assessing merit, the Black Army was foremost.
translations.idiomatic: In the merit roll the Black Army ranked first.

sentences.zh: 及從國王軍征萬奴，圍南京，城堅如立鐵，查剌命偏將先警其東北，親奮長槊大呼，登西南角，摧其飛櫓，手斬陴卒數十人，大軍乘之，遂克南京。

translations.literal: And following the Prince's army in campaigning against Wannu, besieging Nanjing—the walls firm as standing iron—Zhala ordered a flank general first to alarm the northeast; he himself brandished a long spear and shouted loudly, ascended the southwest corner, destroyed their flying galleries, with his own hand beheaded several dozen rampart soldiers; the great army took advantage and thereupon captured Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Wannu he besieged Nanjing, whose walls stood like iron. Zhala sent a flank force to feint northeast while he scaled the southwest corner with a long spear, smashed the siege towers, killed dozens on the wall, and the main force took the city.

sentences.zh: 詰旦，木華黎解錦衣賞之。

translations.literal: At dawn Muqali removed his brocade robe and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn Muqali gave him his own brocade robe as reward.

sentences.zh: 累授真定路達魯花赤，卒于柳城。

translations.literal: Repeatedly appointed darughachi of the Zhending Circuit, he died at Liucheng.
translations.idiomatic: He served repeatedly as darughachi of Zhending and died at Liucheng.

sentences.zh: 子庫祿滿襲職，從攻襄樊，與從弟度剌，立雲梯衝其堞，度剌死焉。

translations.literal: His son Kuluman inherited the post; following the attack on Xiangyang and Fancheng, with his cousin Dulasi he set cloud-ladders to batter the parapet; Dulasi died there.
translations.idiomatic: His son Kuluman inherited and, in the siege of Xiangyang and Fancheng, set siege ladders with his cousin Dulasi, who was killed there.

sentences.zh: 中統三年，庫祿滿從征李璮，先登，飛矢中額而卒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong Kuluman followed the campaign against Li Tan, was first to ascend, was struck by a flying arrow in the forehead and died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1262 Kuluman joined the suppression of Li Tan, was first up the wall, and was killed by an arrow in the forehead.

sentences.zh: 劉斌 思敬

translations.literal: Liu Bin; Sijing.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bin; Sijing

sentences.zh: 劉斌，濟南歷城縣人。

translations.literal: Liu Bin was a man of Licheng County in Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bin came from Licheng county in Jinan.

sentences.zh: 少孤，鞠于大父。

translations.literal: Orphaned in youth, he was reared by his grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young, he was raised by his grandfather.

sentences.zh: 有勇力，從濟南張榮起兵，為管軍千戶。

translations.literal: He had courage and strength; he followed Zhang Rong of Jinan in raising troops and was commander of a thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Brave and strong, he followed Zhang Rong of Jinan in raising troops and became commander of a thousand.

sentences.zh: 歲壬辰，攻河南，以功授中翼都統。

translations.literal: In the year renchen he attacked Henan and for merit was appointed commander of the central wing.
translations.idiomatic: In 1232, in the Henan campaign, he was made commander of the central wing for his service.

sentences.zh: 攻睢陽軍，軍杏堆，距陳州七十里，聞陳整軍於近郊，斌率衆夜破之。

translations.literal: Attacking the Suizhou army, the army was at Xingdui, seventy li from Chenzhou; hearing Chen had assembled troops in the near suburbs, Bin led the multitude by night and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Besieging Suizhou from a camp at Xingdui, seventy li from Chenzhou, he heard Chen was marshaling troops nearby and routed them in a night attack.

sentences.zh: 又擊走太康守兵，擒其將，三日，太康陷。

translations.literal: Again he struck and drove off the Taikang garrison troops, captured their general; in three days Taikang fell.
translations.idiomatic: He then drove off the Taikang garrison, captured its commander, and took Taikang within three days.

sentences.zh: 榮言於帥阿朮魯曰：「太康之平，摧其鋒者，斌也。」

translations.literal: Rong said to Marshal Ajuru: "The pacification of Taikang—he who blunted their edge was Bin."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Rong told Marshal Ajuru, "Taikang fell because Bin broke their spearhead."

sentences.zh: 移屯襄陽，軍乏食，斌知青陵多積穀，前阻大澤，水深不可涉，陳可取狀。

translations.literal: Moving camp to Xiangyang, the army lacked food; Bin knew Qingling had much stored grain; before it was a great marsh, the water deep and not fordable; he presented a plan showing how it could be taken.
translations.idiomatic: When the army moved to Xiangyang and ran short of food, Bin knew Qingling held great stores but was cut off by a deep marsh. He laid out a plan to take it.

sentences.zh: 衆難之。

translations.literal: The multitude found it difficult.
translations.idiomatic: The others objected.

sentences.zh: 斌叱之曰：「彼恃險，不我虞，取可必也。」

translations.literal: Bin scolded them saying: "They rely on the danger and do not expect us—we can surely take it."
translations.idiomatic: Bin rebuked them: "They trust the terrain and will not expect us. We can take it for certain."

sentences.zh: 乃率百騎夜發，獲敵人，使道之前，行汙澤中五十餘里，遇敵兵，斌捨馬揮槊突敵，敗之，得其糧數千斛。

translations.literal: Thereupon he led a hundred horsemen setting out at night, captured an enemy man and made him guide before; traveling fifty-odd li in muddy marsh they met enemy troops; Bin abandoned his horse, brandished his spear and burst into the enemy, defeated them, and obtained several thousand hu of their grain.
translations.idiomatic: He led a hundred horsemen out at night, took a prisoner as guide, crossed fifty li of bog, routed an enemy detachment, and brought back several thousand hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 遷官知中外諸軍事，從攻六安，先登，破其城。

translations.literal: Transferred in office to know all military affairs Chinese and foreign, he followed in attacking Lu'an, was first to ascend, and broke its city.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to oversee military affairs at home and abroad, he followed the attack on Lu'an, was first on the wall, and broke the city.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，擢濟南推官。

translations.literal: In guimao he was selected as Jinan investigating officer.
translations.idiomatic: In 1243 he was chosen as investigating officer of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，授本道左副元帥。

translations.literal: In xinhai he was appointed left vice marshal of this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1251 he was made left vice marshal of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，陞濟南新舊軍萬戶，移鎮邳州，宋將憚之。

translations.literal: In yimao he was advanced to ten-thousand-household of Jinan's old and new armies, shifted to garrison Pizhou, and Song generals feared him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1255 he was made ten-thousand-household of Jinan's old and new armies, transferred to Pizhou, and Song commanders feared him.

sentences.zh: 己未，病，謂其子曰：「居官當廉正自守，毋黷貨以喪身敗家。」

translations.literal: In jiwei he was ill and said to his son: "In office one should guard integrity and self-restraint—do not take bribes to ruin one's person and destroy the family."
translations.idiomatic: In 1259, ill, he told his son, "Hold office with clean integrity. Do not take bribes and destroy yourself and your house."

sentences.zh: 語畢而逝，年六十有二。

translations.literal: When the words were finished he passed away, age sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died as soon as he had spoken, at sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 贈中奉大夫、參知政事、護軍、彭城郡公，諡武莊。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Master of Special Grace, Counselor of the Secretariat, Guardian of the Army, Duke of Pengcheng, with the posthumous title Wuzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Master of Special Grace, counselor of the secretariat, guardian of the army, Duke of Pengcheng, with the posthumous title Wuzhuang.

sentences.zh: 子思敬。

translations.literal: His son was Sijing.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Sijing.

sentences.zh: 思敬，賜名哈八兒都，襲父職，為征行千戶。

translations.literal: Sijing was granted the name Habardu and inherited his father's post as campaign thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: Sijing, granted the name Habardu, inherited his father's post as campaign thousand-household.

sentences.zh: 世祖南征，從董文炳攻臺山寨，先登，中流矢，傷甚，帝親勞賜酒，易金符。

translations.literal: When Shizu campaigned south he followed Dong Wenbing in attacking Taishan stockade, was first to ascend, was struck midstream by an arrow and badly wounded; the Emperor personally comforted him and granted wine, exchanging his gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: In Kublai's southern campaign he followed Dong Wenbing at Taishan stockade, was first up, took a severe arrow wound, and was personally comforted by the emperor with wine and a new gold tally.

sentences.zh: 中統二年，授武衛軍千戶。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhongtong he was appointed thousand-household of the Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In 1261 he was made thousand-household of the Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 從討李璮，賜銀六十錠。

translations.literal: Following in suppressing Li Tan he was granted sixty ingots of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Li Tan he received sixty ingots of silver.

sentences.zh: 四年，授濟南武衛軍緫管，捕盜有功，又賜銀千兩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed overall commander of the Jinan Martial Guard Army; capturing bandits had merit and he was again granted one thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he became overall commander of the Jinan Martial Guard and received another thousand taels of silver for capturing bandits.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，授懷遠大將軍、侍衛親軍左翼副都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan he was appointed Grand General of Cherished Remoteness and left vice commander of the Palace Guard's personal army.
translations.idiomatic: In 1266 he was made Grand General of Cherished Remoteness and left vice commander of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 四年，命築京城。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was ordered to build the capital city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was ordered to help build the capital.

sentences.zh: 八年，授廣威將軍、西川副統軍，佩金虎符。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed General of Broad Might and vice overall commander of Western Chuan, wearing a gold tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was made General of Broad Might and vice commander of western Sichuan, with a gold tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 九年，宋嘉定守臣昝萬壽乘虛攻成都，哈八兒都邀擊，敗之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Song Jiading defending minister Zan Wanshou seized an opening to attack Chengdu; Habardu intercepted and struck him and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Song defender of Jiading, Zan Wanshou, took advantage of a gap in the defenses to strike Chengdu. Habardu intercepted him and routed his force.

sentences.zh: 戰于青城，宋兵大敗，奪所俘二千人還。

translations.literal: Battling at Qingcheng, Song troops were greatly defeated; he seized the two thousand they had captured and returned.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingcheng he inflicted a heavy defeat on the Song and recovered the two thousand prisoners they had taken.

sentences.zh: 十二年，轉同僉行樞密院事，復攻嘉定，取之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was transferred to associate commissioner of the Branch Privy Council, again attacked Jiaoding, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he became associate commissioner of the branch privy council, attacked Jiaoding again, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 瀘、敘、忠、涪諸部，及巴縣籌勝、龜雲、石筍等寨十九族，及西南夷五十六部，悉來降。

translations.literal: The various parts of Lu, Xu, Zhong, and Fu, and the nineteen clans of stockades such as Chousheng, Guiyun, and Shisun in Ba County, and the fifty-six parts of the southwestern Yi—all came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The districts of Lu, Xu, Zhong, and Fu, nineteen stockade clans in Ba county including Chousheng, Guiyun, and Shisun, and fifty-six southwestern tribal groups all submitted.

sentences.zh: 十三年，圍重慶，敗宋將張萬，得其舟百餘。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he besieged Chongqing, defeated the Song general Zhang Wan, and obtained more than a hundred of his boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he besieged Chongqing, defeated the Song commander Zhang Wan, and seized more than a hundred of his ships.

sentences.zh: 六月，瀘州復叛，哈八兒都妻子沒焉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Luzhou rebelled again; Habardu's wife and children were lost there.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Luzhou rebelled again, and Habardu's wife and children were captured there.

sentences.zh: 乃率兵討擒其將任慶，攻破盤山寨，俘九千餘戶，又獲其將劉雄及王世昌等。

translations.literal: Thereupon he led troops to pursue and capture their general Ren Qing, broke Panshan stockade, captured more than nine thousand households, and again seized their generals Liu Xiong and Wang Shichang and others.
translations.idiomatic: He marched out, captured the rebel general Ren Qing, stormed Panshan stockade, took more than nine thousand households prisoner, and also seized the commanders Liu Xiong and Wang Shichang among others.

sentences.zh: 夜入東門，巷戰，殺王安撫等，遂克瀘州。

translations.literal: By night he entered the east gate, fought in the lanes, killed Wang the Pacification Commissioner and others, and thereupon took Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He entered by the east gate at night, fought through the streets, killed the pacification commissioner Wang and others, and retook Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 復攻重慶，其將趙牛子降，禽守臣張珏。

translations.literal: Again he attacked Chongqing; its general Zhao Niuzi surrendered; he seized the defending minister Zhang Jue.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Chongqing again. The commander Zhao Niuzi surrendered, and he captured the defender Zhang Jue.

sentences.zh: 十六年，蜀平，拜中奉大夫、四川行省參知政事。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Shu was pacified; he was appointed Grand Master of Special Grace and associate administrative commissioner of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, when Shu was pacified, he was made Grand Master of Special Grace and associate administrative commissioner of the Sichuan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 行省罷，改四川北道宣慰使。

translations.literal: When the Branch Secretariat was abolished he was changed to pacification commissioner of the Sichuan North Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When the branch secretariat was abolished he was reassigned as pacification commissioner of the northern Sichuan circuit.

sentences.zh: 十七年，授正奉大夫、江西行省參知政事，治吉、贛盜，民賴以安。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was granted Grand Master of the Imperial Favor and associate administrative commissioner of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat; he governed bandits in Ji and Gan; the people relied on this for peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was made Grand Master of the Imperial Favor and associate commissioner of the Jiangxi branch secretariat. By suppressing banditry in Ji and Gan he brought the people security.

sentences.zh: 二十年卒，年五十三。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he died, age fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twentieth year at the age of fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 贈推忠宣力果毅功臣、平章政事、柱國，封濱國公，諡忠肅。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the merit title Loyal and Resolute Merit-Proclaiming Fruitful Valor, Grand Chancellor of the Secretariat, Pillar of the State, enfeoffed as Duke of the Bin State, with the posthumous title Zhongsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as a fruitfully valiant merit lord, grand chancellor, and pillar of the state, enfeoffed as Duke of Bin with the posthumous title Zhongsu.

sentences.zh: 子思恭，字安道，累官昭毅大將軍、右衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: His son Sigong, courtesy name Andao, through repeated offices was Grand General of Manifest Valor and commander of the Right Guard's personal army.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sigong, whose courtesy name was Andao, rose through the ranks to Grand General of Manifest Valor and commander of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 思義，宣武將軍、昌國州軍民達魯花赤。

translations.literal: Siyi was General of Manifest Martiality and darughachi over the troops and civilians of Changguo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Siyi served as General of Manifest Martiality and darughachi over the troops and civilians of Changguo.

sentences.zh: 趙柔，淶水人。

translations.literal: Zhao Rou was a man of Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Rou came from Lishui.

sentences.zh: 有膽略，善騎射，好施予。

translations.literal: He had courage and stratagem, was skilled in mounted archery, and loved to give to others.
translations.idiomatic: He was bold and resourceful, an expert horseman and archer, and generous in giving.

sentences.zh: 金末避兵西山，柵險以保鄉井。

translations.literal: At the end of Jin he avoided warfare in the western mountains, stockaded dangerous places to protect his village and wells.
translations.idiomatic: As the Jin collapsed he withdrew to the western hills, fortifying the passes to protect his home district.

sentences.zh: 時劉伯元、蔡友資、李純等亦各聚衆數千，聞柔信義，共推為長。

translations.literal: At that time Liu Boyuan, Cai Youzi, Li Chun, and others also each gathered crowds of several thousand; hearing of Rou's trust and righteousness, they together pushed him as leader.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Boyuan, Cai Youzi, Li Chun, and others had each raised several thousand men. Hearing of Rou's integrity, they chose him as their leader.

sentences.zh: 柔明號令，嚴約束，重賞罰，為衆所服。

translations.literal: Rou made orders clear, strictly constrained conduct, heavily rewarded and punished, and was submitted to by the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Rou issued clear orders, enforced strict discipline, and rewarded and punished decisively, and the men obeyed him willingly.
